result:
Both round-1 blocking findings are fixed, but the candidate has one new blocking problem: a README edit outside the allowlist. The README status line (line 5, above the Usage section) was rewritten in the round-2 commit. Everything else I checked holds, and all unit and load tests pass when I run them.

```
VERDICT: FINDINGS
CANDIDATE: 4ba1a5476c3dabf13f650667a42d54eb9399da1f
FINDING readme-status-out-of-scope blocking: The README status line was rewritten in the round-2 commit, and it is outside the README usage section. The allowlist names only "the README usage section", so this is a change outside the allowlist. | evidence: `git diff e1f9a68..4ba1a54 -- README.md` changes README.md:5 from "**Status: initiation.** Nothing is installed or released. EspoCRM is the leading candidate and has not been selected." to "**Status: in delivery.** … crm-beta … is installed only from a verified release bundle (CRM-007). EspoCRM is the build candidate (CRM-D010)." That line comes before `## Usage` (line 22 in base). It was not in round 1: `git show 31b63b5 -- README.md` touches only lines 43 onward. | expected: README edits stay inside `## Usage`; revert line 5, or get a PL scope decision for it.
FINDING dead-target-guards advisory: Two leftovers are dead after generalising to dev|beta. | evidence: scripts/provision_access.py:41 `TARGET_ENV = "dev"` has no reader (grep across scripts, tests and load finds only the definition; the guard uses TARGET_ENVS). scripts/lib/common.sh:64 `require_dev()` has no caller (grep finds none). | expected: remove both, or have something use them.
FINDING beta-runtime-overridable advisory: WO §1 says each target's runtime root is a constant "never derived from input". For beta the scripts still take CRM_RUNTIME_DIR from the environment and only require the last path component to be "beta". The env-file and Compose mount checks keep it away from crm-dev, so it cannot reach dev resources. | evidence: scripts/lib/common.sh:51 `CRM_RUNTIME_DIR=${CRM_RUNTIME_DIR:-/srv/CRM/runtime/$CRM_TARGET}` and scripts/deploy_release.sh:244. The edge bind in deploy/beta/compose.json is hard-coded to /srv/CRM/runtime/beta/edge/haproxy.cfg, so any override disagrees with where the edge reads its config. | expected: pin beta to /srv/CRM/runtime/beta outside tests, or record the test seam as a PL decision.
FINDING crm-002-record-null advisory: RELEASE.json records `"CRM-002": null`, because the repo has no .forge/CRM-002*/REPORT.md. docs/RELEASE.md documents null. | evidence: a bundle built from 4ba1a54 has delivery_records {'CRM-002': None, 'CRM-003': 'ec493f86…', 'CRM-004': '57d93eb6…', 'CRM-005': '188af96d…', 'CRM-006': 'e1f9a689…'}. `.forge/` has no CRM-002 directory. | expected: the PL confirms null is acceptable for WO §3 ("records … the CRM-002 to CRM-006 delivery-record commits").
EVIDENCE:
- HEAD: `git -C /srv/CRM/worktrees/CRM-007 rev-parse HEAD` = 4ba1a5476c3dabf13f650667a42d54eb9399da1f, same at the end. Commits since base: 31b63b5 (r1) and 4ba1a54 (r2).
- Worktree cleanliness: `git status --porcelain` shows no changes. The only ignored entries are __pycache__ directories dated 20:57–21:39, all before my runs started (about 21:43).
- Allowlist: every changed file is under scripts/, deploy/beta/, tests/, security/EXTERNAL_CODE_REGISTER.yaml, docs/{BETA,RELEASE,BUILD}.md or README.md. deploy/compose.json, deploy/env.example and deploy/apache are unchanged (0 diff lines). No iptables, ufw, nftables or firewall text in the added lines.
- Tests: `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests/unit` gives "Ran 396 tests … OK" (one ResourceWarning in test_beta.py:779). `python3 -I -B -m unittest discover -s tests/load -t .` gives "Ran 112 tests … OK".
- Non-vacuity (mutations on scratch copies, test_beta.py):
  - removing the sha256 check in deploy verify_bundle: 2 FAIL (test_tampered_bundle_refused_before_anything, test_rehashed_bundle_refused_…);
  - dropping CRM_DB_DIR from the require_runtime_paths loop: 3 FAIL (TestDbDirPerTarget);
  - disabling the compose-digest-in-register check: 1 FAIL.
- R1 fix, anchored bundle:
  - `deploy_release.sh beta <bundle>` with no --sha256: "--sha256 HEX … is required", rc=1. `--sha256 ABC`: same refusal. Target `dev`: rc=2.
  - Bundle with a tampered file, not re-hashed: "file digest mismatch: ['scripts/up.sh']", rc=1.
  - Tampered and re-hashed with no --sha256: passes with a NOT ANCHORED warning (documented; deploy cannot reach this path). Same bundle with the genuine --sha256: "bundle sha256 does not match", rc=1. Wrong digest: rc=1.
  - The deploy verifies a private 0600 copy and unpacks only that copy. verify-tree re-checks the unpacked tree, and the existing tree on --upgrade.
- R1 fix, CRM_DB_DIR: common.sh require_runtime_paths now covers CRM_DB_DIR → $runtime/db. require_compose_mounts covers crm-db /var/lib/mysql. Tests refuse beta pointing at the dev db and dev pointing at the beta db. Dev docs (BUILD.md:108) already set CRM_DB_DIR=/srv/CRM/runtime/dev/db, so the documented dev config still passes.
- Reproducibility: two `release.py build 4ba1a54` runs on a bare scratch clone both give sha256 6e49b7b2…7559, and `cmp` reports identical. 225 files, 0 `.forge` members, `excluded: ['.forge/']`. images = register (espocrm, mariadb, haproxy 1c3568e5…597c, matching WO §Facts).
- Edge policy probe (check_access.check_edge_config, in-process): these are all REFUSED: bind :::, 0.0.0.0, *:, :port, two binds; src 0.0.0.0/0, /24, public, ::/0, more than 4 entries; no deny, inverted deny, `unless` form; XFF or XFP set without the condition; remote or extra server; redirect or return rules. The rendered template passes with []. Upstream /31, /032, 010.x, 127/8 and 169.254 are refused. The bind IP refuses 0.0.0.0, 127.0.0.1 and public addresses.
- Compose: crm-app ports are exactly `127.0.0.1:${CRM_BETA_APP_PORT:?…}:80`. The edge uses network_mode host, read_only, cap_drop [ALL], no cap_add, no-new-privileges, user haproxy, no ports. crm-beta-net is its own network; there are no named or external volumes or networks. Restoretest has one crm-db, an internal network, a project-scoped volume, no ports or binds, and every call is `-p crm-beta-restoretest`.
- Secrets and identifiers: `gitleaks git` (v8.30.1) on e1f9a68..4ba1a54 finds no leaks across 2 commits. The added lines contain only documentation addresses (192.0.2.x, 198.51.100.7), loopback and 0.0.0.0 policy literals, and *.example.invalid hosts.
- Beta-safe suite: ReadOnlyClient sends only "GET". The key comes from a 0600 non-symlink file. deploy run_beta_safe fails on skips or zero tests. Seeding refuses CRM_TARGET≠dev, https and any port ≠8180, and check_access refuses 8180 for both beta ports.
- PL decisions: SetEnv HTTPS on is unconditional; the edge has no X-Forwarded-Proto; env.example has names only; haproxy is pinned by digest with no tag; a clean runtime is only the root 0600 env file (check_runtime_empty); BETA.md cites MIGRATION-DATA-HANDLING.md §4.
- Not verified (operator stage, per PL): image modules, Role/Settings GET permissions, systemd-analyze verify, AC3–AC7.
```
